notes.title: Barbecue game release with friends
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44823033/31f5194d59e55e29b220df0e78f0893e8ee04e90.jpg[/img]
In the game you will make marinade, prepare coals and roast kebabs! You can also blow up a barbecue with a fart, 
put a friend on a skewer and have a beer! And you can also go to the sauna!
We take the brothers and run to the barbecue
